bio: John Crawford has served with The Navigators for more than 63 years. His tenure began in 1947 when Dawson Trotman encouraged him to invest in the lives of men and build disciples who could teach others also. He worked with servicemen in California, then helped to develop The Navigators Glen Eyrie headquarters in Colorado Springs. John and his wife Helen served nine years in New Zealand, and since 1980 have lived in Oklahoma City where John serves as The Navigators Area Representative.
